response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as share_percentage FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY record_count DESC
